initialSeal.message: Resolved reporter smoke differs from frozen command

cause: Locked parseCLI mutates supplied argv in place: first element becomes /index.js and node is prepended. Initial seal compared raw launcher prefixes, despite exact parsed/resolved options.
correction: Require recorded parser prefix exactly [node,/index.js], frozen launcher exactly [pnpm,exec,vitest], then compare run/file/all options/output suffix byte-for-byte.
